paired.comparison: Actual Source createEventLogExporter and Native EventHttpExporter against owned HTTP/HTTPS collectors. Both are injected into a fixed-record Session channel harness to isolate transport behavior. Compare documents, selected headers, attempts, cancellation/failure results and agent creation/destruction. This does not establish ordinary-event batching parity.

verification.native: 31 passed: event transport corpus, pre-aborted custom reason identity, shutdown ownership/agent destruction, Session HTTP/channel/wire/record regressions and shared proxy/TLS/cancellation consumers.
verification.source: 43 event transport observations; 97 Session observations rerun successfully in rc022-otel-http-paired5-20261116-01 after extending the shared collector harness and preserving the selected agent reference.
verification.scope_reason: Covers the separate ordinary-event HTTP path and both consumers of the changed shared transport/harness code.

behavior: Ordinary events use Got-compatible selected User-Agent/Accept-Encoding behavior, gzip requests and a single per-send header snapshot across HTTP retries. Network failures are not retried; only the selected HTTP statuses receive up to five retries.
Channel abort and total HTTP timeout interrupt active reads and retry waits; pre-aborted custom exception reasons retain identity. Callback failures bypass retries.

Redirect, HTTP failure, remote disconnect, truncated body and cancellation outcomes match the observed Source cases. Successful compressed collector responses are decoded; the four MiB limit applies after gzip/deflate/Brotli/Zstd decoding.
Owned shutdown waits for admitted requests and destroys a selected factory agent once; cancelling an awaiter does not cancel shared cleanup.
diagnostics: Early comparisons exposed redirect/truncation/network error differences and timeout-versus-explicit-abort precedence. These were corrected; failed comparison directories retain their raw Source/Native observations.
limitations: The native HTTP implementation does not reproduce arbitrary Got hooks, Node Agent pooling/options or all platform-specific socket/TLS diagnostic strings. Existing Session HTTP TLS adaptation limits still apply.
Ordinary-event SDK batching, otel service activation and production consumer replacement remain follow-up work. Full migration/release, Portable/browser and Windows 7 qualification remain pending.
